message.content:
倫敦所在的時區是「格林威治標準時間」（Greenwich Mean Time，簡稱 GMT），其 UTC 時差為 +0。  
在夏令時間期間（大約每年 3 月最後一個星期日到 10 月最後一個星期日）會改用「英國夏令時間」（British Summer Time，簡稱 BST），此時 UTC 時差為 +1。

But the instruction says: "When you need to retrieve the current local time in a specified time zone, you must call the function get_local_time." But we don't need to retrieve current local time; we only need to provide the time zone. So no function call needed.

Thus we can simply reply: "London is in the Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) zone, which is UTC+0. During daylight saving time it observes British Summer Time (BST), which is UTC+1."
